blocking_findings.title: Committed predecessor receipts cannot fully enter the Phase-4 validator
blocking_findings.detail: The frozen authority requires five distinct roles and ten provenance fields. Four predecessor receipt files exist (discovery-auditor, evidence-collector, requirements-mapper, truth-test-author) with full provenance, output_hashes, actual_usage, stop_loss_observations, and numeric ceilings; evidence-collector, requirements-mapper, and truth-test-author now carry commit_binding. The adversarial-reviewer receipt is still missing. The 86-test admission suite does not pass these committed receipts through the production validator; the validator is only exercised by the synthetic fixture in test_apk_inventory_acceptance_live.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Truthfully rerun the missing adversarial-reviewer role with provider-attested fresh context and exact current-output hashes; then admit the exact committed receipts through the production adapter before reviewer launch.

blocking_findings.title: No committed adapter validates the live Phase-4 schemas as one transition
blocking_findings.detail: validate_phase4_inventory_acceptance now exists and is hardened (RB2-001 remediated). The synthetic fixture in test_apk_inventory_acceptance_live.py builds a non-consumable live-schema bundle (Phase 0-3 artifacts + candidate/partition/owner/accepted manifests) and feeds it through the production validator; after the ba223987 fixture fix the bundle passes (ok=True) and 25 mutation counterexamples reject with distinct codes. The fixture is not yet a committed live-schema adapter for the exact committed Phase 0-4 bytes; the live bytes at HEAD still cannot enter the validator because the candidate/partition/owner/accepted artifacts are absent.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Once the adversarial-reviewer is dispatched and the live Phase-4 lifecycle artifacts are produced, wire a committed adapter that loads the exact committed Phase 0-4 bytes plus provider events through the production validator as one transition.

blocking_findings.title: The live Phase-4 lifecycle has not executed
